purpose: short-KUTs must be immediate-use emotional/audio objects, not song excerpts with dead lead-in or drift-out.

rules.rule: An sK must start at the first usable emotional, vocal, hook, phrase, or unmistakable sonic-identity moment.
Cut all music-only intro from sKs unless the music-only intro is itself the emotional object being sold or studied.
Cut music-only tail after the usable emotional/vocal/action moment resolves.
A tiny lead or tail pad is allowed only when it prevents a hard cut, protects a vocal attack, protects a final consonant, or preserves a sustaining note.
An sK with music-only intro or music-only tail is not approved; mark ADJUST / TRIM.
No audio review player may be delivered unless the referenced audio file exists and has duration greater than zero.

decisionLanguage.approve: starts fast, carries usable meaning, ends clean
decisionLanguage.adjustIntro: trim music-only intro; start at first usable emotional/vocal/sonic moment
decisionLanguage.adjustTail: trim music-only tail; end after phrase or moment resolves
decisionLanguage.adjustCutoff: fix cutoff; do not cut phrase, final consonant, or sustaining note
